title: OutcomesActionPayload
description: Record an observed matching outcome. Distinct from the typed OutcomeFeedback ingest model and sync(entity_type=outcome) path. Source: engine/handlers.py:handle_outcomes() at bcf66bdbf56f7c35d059a6e16c3006bcc1395ba0. Packet tenant is supplied by the chassis, not by this payload.

value.description: Optional numeric outcome magnitude; handler passes value to graph/feedback.

source_ts.description: Causal validation source timestamp; used only if causal validation enabled.

target_ts.description: Causal validation target timestamp; used only if causal validation enabled.

match_packet_id.description: Optional packet-store linkage when outcome_persistence_enabled; not a tenant id.

outcome_id.description: Optional replay key (outcome_idempotency_enabled, FEEDBACK-IDEMP-01): a replay with the same id records nothing new and propagates at most once; a replay with different match_id, candidate_id or outcome is refused. Omitted: the server mints an id, and a retry cannot be recognised.

query_entity_id.description: Optional, additive (L8 item 3, outcome_preference_history_enabled): the declared id of the query entity this outcome answers, on the fingerprint direction's queryentity label. Given, handle_outcomes also links that entity to the outcome node the way a preference_attention dimension reads it. Omitted or null: the outcome is written exactly as before.

dimension_scores.description: Optional per-dimension finite numeric scores; finite check is runtime _outcome_feedback_fields.

was_selected.description: Optional selection state; _outcome_feedback_fields checks bool or None, when outcome_schema_unified.

x-side-effects: write: outcome record and potentially feedback/causal edges gated by domain/settings
x-schema-role: bounded public client contract; the legacy handler may ignore extra keys

x-conditional-fields.runtime_policy: Nonfinite dimension scores or non-boolean selection rejected by _outcome_feedback_fields; disabled flag changes enforcement and persistence.
x-conditional-fields.query_entity_id_when: outcome_preference_history_enabled=True (default) and the pack declares a preference_attention dimension for the direction
x-conditional-fields.query_entity_id_runtime_policy: A bool, empty, non-string non-integer id, an ambiguous queryentity label or a dimension reading another outcome node is refused by _preference_history_plan before the outcome is written; flag off, the key is ignored.
